topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and sets expectations regarding complement's complexity and relevance.

topics.label: Foundations and central role of C3 in the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational architecture, naming conventions, and central biochemical importance of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the three distinct recognition mechanisms that initiate complement and converge to reach the critical activation threshold.

topics.label: Downstream effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the primary functional processes through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and promotes inflammation.

topics.label: Host regulation and protection against complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory factors and biochemical mechanisms that prevent complement from damaging host cells.

topics.label: Clinical pathology of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the diverse clinical presentations and disease risks associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen strategies for complement evasion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the evolutionary mechanisms employed by pathogens such as Staphylococcus aureus to circumvent complement-mediated clearance.

topics.label: Lecture wrap-up and conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on the adaptive immune system.
